The JSX namespace in TypeScript

The global JSX namespace is removed. Use React.JSX.

old: JSX.Element
new: React.JSX.Element

<!-- do not edit; generated from pack v0.3.0 -->

# nextjs-upgrade 15

- `next/async-cookies` (changed_behavior): cookies() is async
- `next/async-draft-mode` (changed_behavior): draftMode() is async
- `next/async-headers` (changed_behavior): headers() is async
- `next/async-params` (changed_behavior): params is a Promise
- `next/async-request-ip` (removed): NextRequest.ip is removed
- `next/async-search-params` (changed_behavior): searchParams is a Promise
- `next/bundlepagesrouterdependencies` (renamed): bundlePagesRouterDependencies
- `next/nextrequest-geolocation` (removed): NextRequest Geolocation
- `next/react-19` (peer_requirement): App Router requires React 19
- `next/route-handlers` (changed_default): Route Handlers
- `next/runtime-configuration-breaking-change` (removed): runtime configuration (Breaking change)
- `next/serverexternalpackages` (renamed): serverExternalPackages

draftMode() is async

draftMode() from next/headers is asynchronous.

old: const { isEnabled } = draftMode()
new: const { isEnabled } = await draftMode()

useRef requires an argument

useRef requires an argument, and MutableRefObject is deprecated in favour of RefObject.

old: useRef()
new: useRef(undefined), or useRef(null)

Route Handlers

GET route handlers are no longer cached by default.

old: export function GET() {}
new: export const dynamic = 'force-static' when the old cached behaviour is required

Removed: ReactDOM.hydrate

ReactDOM.hydrate is removed. Use hydrateRoot.

old: ReactDOM.hydrate(element, container)
new: hydrateRoot(container, element)

Removed: Legacy Context using contextTypes and getChildContext

Legacy context (contextTypes, childContextTypes, getChildContext) is removed.

old: contextTypes and getChildContext
new: contextType or createContext

Removed: react-test-renderer/shallow

react-test-renderer/shallow is removed. Import react-shallow-renderer directly.

old: import ShallowRenderer from 'react-test-renderer/shallow'
new: import ShallowRenderer from 'react-shallow-renderer'

serverExternalPackages

experimental.serverComponentsExternalPackages was renamed to serverExternalPackages.

old: experimental.serverComponentsExternalPackages
new: serverExternalPackages

Removed: propTypes and defaultProps for functions

propTypes are ignored and defaultProps on function components are removed. Class components still support defaultProps.

old: Component.defaultProps = { text: "Hello" }
new: a default parameter

The match binds defaultProps on function components. The section's prop-types-typescript codemod covers propTypes only, so it is not named here.

<!-- do not edit; generated from pack v0.3.0 -->

# nextjs-upgrade 14

- `next/the-next-font-package-has-been-fully-removed-in-favor-of-the` (removed): The @next/font package has been fully removed in favor of the built-in next/font. A codemod is available to safely and automatically rename your imports.

Removed: string refs

String refs are removed.

old: <div ref="input" />
new: a ref callback or a ref object

Removed: ReactDOM.findDOMNode

findDOMNode is removed.

old: findDOMNode(component)
new: a ref on the DOM node

NextRequest.ip is removed

NextRequest.ip was removed along with geo.

old: request.ip
new: the hosting provider

The version 15 geolocation section covers both geo and ip. geo has its own rule; this one binds ip.

App Router requires React 19

The App Router requires react and react-dom 19. The Pages Router can stay on 18.

old: react 18 with the App Router
new: react 19

The Pages Router may stay on React 18. The match is an app-router file, and the engine still applies the requirement when that match finds nothing, with a note that it may not be needed.

Removed: React.createFactory

React.createFactory is removed.

old: React.createFactory(Component)
new: the component itself, as JSX

runtime configuration (Breaking change)

Segment config runtime: 'experimental-edge' is rejected; use 'edge'.

old: export const runtime = 'experimental-edge'
new: export const runtime = 'edge'

Removed: react-dom/test-utils

react-dom/test-utils is removed. Import act from react.

old: import { act } from 'react-dom/test-utils'
new: import { act } from 'react'

Removed: unmountComponentAtNode

unmountComponentAtNode is removed. Use root.unmount().

old: unmountComponentAtNode(container)
new: root.unmount()

searchParams is a Promise

searchParams in page props is a Promise.

old: const { q } = searchParams
new: const { q } = await searchParams

Removed: ReactDOM.render

ReactDOM.render is removed. Use createRoot.

old: ReactDOM.render(element, container)
new: createRoot(container).render(element)

headers() is async

headers() from next/headers is asynchronous.

old: const headersList = headers()
new: const headersList = await headers()

The @next/font package has been fully removed in favor of the built-in next/font. A codemod is available to safely and automatically rename your imports.

The @next/font package is gone; the built-in next/font replaces it.

old: import { Inter } from '@next/font/google'
new: import { Inter } from 'next/font/google'

params is a Promise

params in page, layout and route props is a Promise.

old: const { slug } = params
new: const { slug } = await params

<!-- do not edit; generated from pack v0.3.0 -->

# react changes

- `react/removed-legacy-context-using-contexttypes-and-getchildcontex` (19, removed): Removed: Legacy Context using contextTypes and getChildContext
- `react/removed-proptypes-and-defaultprops-for-functions` (19, removed): Removed: propTypes and defaultProps for functions
- `react/removed-react-createfactory` (19, removed): Removed: React.createFactory
- `react/removed-react-dom-test-utils` (19, removed): Removed: react-dom/test-utils
- `react/removed-react-test-renderer-shallow` (19, removed): Removed: react-test-renderer/shallow
- `react/removed-reactdom-finddomnode` (19, removed): Removed: ReactDOM.findDOMNode
- `react/removed-reactdom-hydrate` (19, removed): Removed: ReactDOM.hydrate
- `react/removed-reactdom-render` (19, removed): Removed: ReactDOM.render
- `react/removed-string-refs` (19, removed): Removed: string refs
- `react/removed-unmountcomponentatnode` (19, removed): Removed: unmountComponentAtNode
- `react/the-jsx-namespace-in-typescript` (19, removed): The JSX namespace in TypeScript
- `react/useref-requires-an-argument` (19, changed_behavior): useRef requires an argument

bundlePagesRouterDependencies

experimental.bundlePagesExternals was renamed to bundlePagesRouterDependencies.

old: experimental.bundlePagesExternals
new: bundlePagesRouterDependencies

cookies() is async

cookies() from next/headers is asynchronous. A synchronous call warns, and the warning becomes an error in 16.

old: const cookieStore = cookies()
new: const cookieStore = await cookies()

NextRequest Geolocation

NextRequest.geo and NextRequest.ip were removed. The host provides those values.

old: request.geo and request.ip
new: the hosting provider, for example geolocation() from @vercel/functions

The same removal covers NextRequest.ip. One match binds the geo property; ip is the same section.

- `next-codemod:metadata-to-viewport-export`: no reviewed rule names it
- `next-codemod:middleware-to-proxy`: next/middleware-to-proxy
- `next-codemod:next-async-request-api`: next/async-cookies, next/async-draft-mode, next/async-headers, next/async-params, next/async-search-params
- `next-codemod:next-lint-to-eslint-cli`: next/next-lint-command
- `next-codemod:next-og-import`: no reviewed rule names it
- `next-codemod:next-request-geo-ip`: next/async-request-ip, next/nextrequest-geolocation
- `next-codemod:remove-experimental-ppr`: no reviewed rule names it
- `next-codemod:remove-unstable-prefix`: next/cachelife-and-cachetag
- `next-codemod:upgrade`: no reviewed rule names it
- `react-codemod:migration-recipe-19`: no reviewed rule names it
- `react-codemod:prop-types-typescript`: no reviewed rule names it
- `react-codemod:replace-act-import`: react/removed-react-dom-test-utils
- `react-codemod:replace-reactdom-render`: react/removed-reactdom-hydrate, react/removed-reactdom-render, react/removed-unmountcomponentatnode
- `react-codemod:replace-string-ref`: react/removed-string-refs
- `react-codemod:replace-use-form-state`: no reviewed rule names it
- `types-react-codemod:no-implicit-ref-callback-return`: no reviewed rule names it
- `types-react-codemod:preset-19`: react/the-jsx-namespace-in-typescript
- `types-react-codemod:refobject-defaults`: react/useref-requires-an-argument
